answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can treat each identity like a prism: one reputation score is split into separate facets — bonded stake, verified work history, and peer endorsements — so a fake identity cannot fake all three at once. Newcomers start as a whisper, with tiny transaction limits, and only earn full trust after sustained, attested work. The vertex of the check is that every endorsement must come from an already-vetted agent with skin in the game, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs more in bonded stake than the fraud could ever return.
